title: Tuna black bean salsa bowl
summary: Tuna black bean salsa bowl is a mexican dinner built around tuna in spring water and canned black beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook tuna in spring water for Tuna black bean salsa bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm canned sweetcorn alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss canned black beans with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Tuna black bean salsa bowl straight away. Taste Tuna black bean salsa bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
